samples.reason: This is a well-specified request for a structured, procedural output (5-step decision-making framework). While not highly specialized, it's a clear-cut task with definite completion criteria. Petrel shows stronger performance across all internal routing evals including Extraction & Retrieval and Summarization (85.3 and 86.4 vs Plover's 79.2 and 80.6), and would reliably deliver the systematic breakdown requested. Plover's documented aversion to open-ended generative work makes it less ideal despite comparable capability here.

This is an open-ended generative task requesting a structured process/framework. While both models are capable, Petrel shows stronger overall performance on creative generation tasks (84.7 vs 82.7) and has no measured aversion to open-ended work. Plover self-reports significant aversion to high-latitude generative tasks despite capable output, making Petrel the better routing choice for optimal user experience.
